description: Classic Christmas sugar cookies🍪🎄RECIPE BELOW⬇️ INGREDIENTS: •1/2 cup unsalted butter at room temp •1 egg •1 tsp vanilla extract •1/2 tsp almond extract  •1 1/2 cup flour  •3/4 cup sugar  •1/4 tsp salt •1/4 tsp baking soda •1/4 tsp baking powder •holiday sprinkles  Frosting: •3-4 tbsp milk (start with 3, add in another tbsp if needed to get preferred consistency) •4 cups powder sugar  •4 tbsp butter at room temp •2 tsp vanilla extract Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit. Start by mixing the butter and sugar together with a whisk or hand mixer until it forms a fluffy consistency. Then mix in the egg, vanilla extract, and almond extract until just combined. In a separate bowl, combine the flour, salt, baking powder, and baking soda. Mix it in with the wet ingredients until a dough forms. Add in holiday sprinkles if using. Form the dough into 1 inch balls and place onto a prepared baking sheet. Use the bottom of a glass or measuring cup lightly coated with flour to flatten the cookie dough balls. Make sure to coat again with flour every couple cookies to help prevent sticking. Bake for 10-11 min. Let them cool off, then use a piping bag and tip to decorate with the prepared frosting. Decorate with holiday sprinkles and enjoy🎄✨ #christmasbaking #holidaybaking #sugarcookies #bakingrecipe #holidays
